answer: A court reporter tenure with transcript archive history works as the gate: transcripts filed for one court across years. Each of 345 aliases needs its own transcript archives, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The orchard test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The grove signal is visible to every grader, and the falcon ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
